Candida auris Fungus Cases Detected Across 27 US States

The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) has identified 3,437 cases of the fungus Candida auris across 27 U.S. states as of July 25. This superbug poses a significant threat, particularly to individuals with weakened immune systems. The coverage details the causes, symptoms, spread, and treatment options for the infection.
